title: 第十章 嘭嘭嘭！不偏不向，一人两拳
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那个叫朱顺的进屋后，沈时觐结结实实的揍了他一顿，听到这屋的动静，立刻赶了过来。

原以为林栀会受欺负，想替她讨回公道。

进了屋才知道，她不光一个打三个，还把他们收拾得服服帖帖的。

他渐渐反应过来。

林栀说的让他支持她，不是要他保护她。

而是……不要阻止她动手打人。

想到自己刚才的担心，他不自在地咳了声。

林柔不想被沈时觐看到自己这副丑样子，捂着脸从炕上扑下去，哭哭啼啼地跑了出去。

陈琴想去追她，双腿才迈步，林栀就叫住了她。

“站住，我准你走了吗？”

陈琴扭头看她，眼珠子瞪得老大：“你个反了天的狗东西，连自己爹妈和亲姐都打，你还是人吗？我还没跟你计较呢！你不依不饶的想干嘛？”

这个死丫头一向窝囊听话。

自打沈时觐来了，就跟变了个人似的。

这是有人撑腰了就要翻脸？

哼！她想嫁进沈家享福？门都没有。

她看向沈时觐，一脸无奈。

“时觐，你也都看到了，那我就不瞒你了，这丫头在家里混的很，打老骂少的没个人样，我不能为了把她嫁出去就坑害你们家，柔柔才是你最好的选择。”

林大国捂着受伤的老腰半靠在墙边，附和道：“是啊，时觐，你要是娶她进门，全家都得遭殃，你听我的，选柔柔。”

沈时觐经过今晚的事算是看透了他们夫妻俩，他眼眸微沉，没有说话。

林栀目光扫向陈总和林大国，厉声道：

“我动手打林柔，那是因为她半夜钻我男人被窝。”

“你俩挨打，那是因为你们为了拆散我和沈时觐，在我喝的水里下料，指使村长家那个猪头儿子毁我清白，你们三个没一个是无辜的，挨揍不冤。”

“你们这么害我，我不仅要揍你们，还要把你们通通送去蹲局子。”

沈时觐听到林栀说他是他男人时，眉头动了动，心底涌起一股异样情绪。

这感觉怪怪的，他说不清楚。

Page (1/3)

After the man named Zhu Shun entered the house, Shen Shijin gave him a good beating. Hearing the noise in the house, he rushed over immediately.

I thought Lin Zhi would be bullied and wanted to seek justice for her.

After entering the house, I realized that she not only beat three of them one by one, but also kept them in order.

He gradually came to his senses.

Lin Zhi asked him to support her, not to protect her.

But... don't stop her from hitting someone.

Thinking of his worries just now, he coughed uncomfortably.

Lin Rou didn't want Shen Shijin to see her ugly appearance, so she covered her face and threw herself off the kang, running out crying.

Chen Qin wanted to chase her, but as soon as her legs took a step forward, Lin Zhi stopped her.

"Stop, am I allowed to leave?"

Chen Qin turned to look at her, her eyes widened: "You rebellious bitch, you even beat up your own parents and sister, are you still a human being? I haven't argued with you yet! What do you want to do with your persistence?"

This damn girl has always been cowardly and obedient.

It's as if he has become a different person since the day he was sinking.

Are you going to fall out because someone is backing you?

snort!Does she want to marry into the Shen family and enjoy happiness?There are no doors.

She looked at Shen Shijin with a look of helplessness.

"Shi Jin, you've seen it too, so I won't hide it from you. This girl is really messing around in the family. She has no dignity when she beats the old and scolds the young. I can't harm your family just to marry her off. Rourou is your best choice."

Lin Daguo held his injured waist and leaned half against the wall, and echoed: "Yes, Shi Jin, if you marry her, the whole family will suffer. You listen to me and choose Rourou."

After what happened tonight, Shen Shijin finally saw through the couple. His eyes darkened slightly and he said nothing.

Lin Zhi glanced at Mr. Chen and Lin Daguo and said sternly:

"I hit Lin Rou because she got into my man's bed in the middle of the night."

"You two were beaten because, in order to break up Shen Shijin and I, you put ingredients in the water I drank and instigated the village chief's pig-headed son to destroy my innocence. None of the three of you are innocent, and the beatings are not unjust."

"If you hurt me like this, I will not only beat you up, but I will also send you all to jail."

When Shen Shijin heard Lin Zhi say that he was his man, his brows moved, and a strange emotion surged in his heart.

It felt weird, he couldn't explain it.
